_doc: Signals ml/c3/signal_audit.py may find UNUSED or ZERO-GRAD without failing the runE.sh SIGNAL_AUDIT=1 smoke. Each needs a reason; a labeled signal that should teach the model never goes here. See ~/c3-local/runE/signal_audit.md.
note.parser: The [parser] line is a remark about the parse, not the deal; the note grammar drops it from training (owner rule 2026-10-03, notes.split_note / drop_meta).
read.co_company: meta.bookkeeping (app/core/label_heads.json): whose policy the row carries; never a task or an input.
read.deal_outcome: meta.bookkeeping (app/core/label_heads.json): how the deal ended; never a task or an input.
read.governs_count: meta.bookkeeping (app/core/label_heads.json): backfill scratch; the governs links themselves train (link.governs).
read.derived_from_count: meta.bookkeeping (app/core/label_heads.json): backfill scratch; the derived_from links themselves train.
label.supersedes: Approval bookkeeping: an approved draft replaces the saved row it names at load (loop.accept_drafts); the draft's own fields are what train.
card_meta.supersedes: Approval bookkeeping: an approved draft card replaces the saved card it names at load (loop.accept_drafts).
label.is_new_type: Page bookkeeping: the type was added to the registry while labeling; label_type itself trains.
label.reads_kept: Page bookkeeping: which parser readings the labeler kept; the kept readings are in reads_set and train there.
label.coarse: Derived from label_type (app/core/label_heads.json content.type: 'coarse and facet are derived'); label_type trains.
